name: ioctl_console
synopsis: int ioctl(int fd, unsigned long request, void *argp);
description: The ioctl system call for console terminals and virtual consoles performs various device-specific operations, such as managing LEDs, keyboard settings, and video modes. It requires a file descriptor for a console device and uses request codes to specify the action.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the console device

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The ioctl request code (e.g., KDGETLED, KDSETLED)

parameters.name: argp
parameters.description: Pointer to the argument structure or value for the request

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The file descriptor or argp is invalid
The file descriptor is not associated with a character special device, or the specified operation does not apply to it

bugs: Some subcodes, such as those for dumping the screen or getting task information, have been removed in later kernel versions like Linux 1.1.92.
versions: Various operations since Linux 1.1.54 and later, with some dating back to Linux 0.99pl1.
